svg.desc: Compact four-step practical guidance; editable text.
svg.text: Box 1. Choosing and evaluating a spectral decomposition model
Specify the quantity and frequency range you want to estimate.
Choose a spectral estimator and a likelihood appropriate
Choose plausible rhythm bands, broadband structure,
priors, and how the components combine.
Compare held-out likelihood and assess recovery of the
target in matched simulations with known truth.
